add_common_server_args: add common server arguments like memsize, nic-channel-ratio, and thread ratios to an argparse ArgumentParser
add_common_client_args: add common client arguments like server-hostname, num-threads, and target-hit-ratio to an argparse ArgumentParser
get_proc_meminfo: parse /proc/meminfo and return a dictionary of memory keys mapped to byte values
get_system_memsize_gb: get the total system memory size in gigabytes by reading /proc/meminfo
get_warmup_time: calculate the warmup time in seconds based on memory size or return a user-specified value
